items.title: What I learned from failure: Female leaders weigh in on hard lessons at work
items.excerpt: 18 Apr 2024 – Acestar Group CEO and Young President’s Association (YPO) Malaysia member Natalie Sit has similar leadership advice to offer, reflecting back on the early days of starting her company. Despite coming from humble beginnings, Ipoh-born Sit was highly driven and worked hard to make a name for herself as a tech entrepreneur in the creative software industry. “In the first few years of starting my business, I had no clue on how to be a boss,” Sit says. “I didn’t know how to instruct people to do a job. In hindsight, a bad decision I made early on was getting a room for myself and separating myself from my team of just three or four employees at the time. I thought that was a norm,” she adds.

items.title: Universiti Teknologi Mara Lancar Certiport Authorized Testing Center
items.excerpt: SHAH ALAM, 3 OKTOBER 2022 – Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM) telah melancarkan Certiport Authorized Testing Center (CATC) bagi meningkatkan kemahiran pensyarah dan pelajar dalam teknologi yang telah dibangunkan oleh Microsoft. Majlis ini telah dirasmikan oleh Naib Canselor UiTM, YBhg Prof. Datuk Ts. Dr Hajah Roziah Mohd Janor. Dalam usaha untuk meningkatkan kebolehpasaran graduan, UiTM berkolaborasi bersama Microsoft, Acestar dan SoftwareONE melancarkan Certiport Authorized Testing Centre (CATC) di Kolej Pengajian Pengkomputeran, Informatik dan Media. Hasil kerjasama ini akan melengkapkan pelajar untuk memiliki pensijilan yang diikitiraf industri. Lebih menarik lagi, menerusi MoU UiTM dengan Microsoft , para pelajar berpeluang menduduki peperiksaan pensijilan dengan potongan yuran sebanyak 90%. YBhg Prof. Datuk Ts. Dr Hajah Roziah Mohd Janor, Naib Canselor UiTM berkata, beliau yakin bahawa inisiatif ini akan memberi UiTM peluang untuk kemajuan akademik yang lebih ketara, pembangunan pelajar yang lebih unggul, dan penerokaan penyelidikan. “Arus teknologi yang sentiasa berkembang, datang dengan cabaran yang perlu ditangani oleh semua pihak. Kolaborasi dengan rakan strategik seperti Microsoft, Acestar and SoftwareONE membolehkan peralihan teknologi dapat ditangani secara optimum di semua peringkat’. Beliau turut menambah bahawa penubuhan CATC ini akan dapat melahirkan graduan yang mempunyai pensijilan diiktiraf oleh industri glbal, berinovasi dan berkemahiran tinggi dalam sektor pendigitalan, di mana ia membolehkan UiTM meluaskan rangkaian kerjasama globalnya bagi memastikan institusi awam itu akan menjadi Universiti Terkenal Global dalam bidang sains dan teknologi, kemanusiaan dan keusahawanan menjelang 2025. Majlis ini turut dihadiri oleh Tuan Sheikh Manzoor, General Manager (Public Sector Group) Microsoft Malaysia, Cik Natalie Sit, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Acestar Sdn Bhd, Ms Georgie Tham, Enterprise Account Manager SoftwareONE Sdn. Bhd dan Prof. Ts Dr Haryani Haron, Penolong Naib Canselor Kolej Pengajian Pengkomputeran, Informatik dan Media.

items.title: UITM Menerima Jemputan Khas Ke Sidang Kemuncak Pendidikan Micro-Credentials 2023 Dan MEerah Anugerah Berprestij Sebagi Pusat Ujian Sah Certipot Malaysia
items.excerpt: UiTM Menerima Jemputan Khas Ke Sidang Kemuncak Pendidikan Micro-Credentials 2023 Dan Meraih Anugerah Berprestij Sebagai Pusat Ujian Sah Certiport Malaysia Pada 1 Jun 2023, Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM) Shah Alam telah diberikan penghormatan yang signifikan dan saya menerima jemputan khas untuk menghadiri Sidang Kemuncak Pendidikan Micro-Credentials 2023. Universiti ini juga telah diiktiraf dan dianugerahkan sebagai Pusat Ujian Sah Certiport Malaysia (CATC) untuk Microsoft, mengukuhkan lagi komitmennya terhadap kecemerlangan pendidikan dan teknologi. Sidang Kemuncak Pendidikan Micro-Credentials 2023, sempena Grand Finale Kejohanan Kebangsaan Malaysia 2023, telah dijadualkan berlangsung pada 1 Jun 2023, di Connexion Conference & Event Centre di Bangsar South, Kuala Lumpur. Sidang kemuncak itu dimulakan dengan ucapan pembukaan bertajuk “Future-Proofing the World Economy with Micro-Credentials” oleh Benjamin Yeoh, Pengurus Kanan Pembangunan Perniagaan di Acestar Group. Ini diikuti dengan ucaptama daripada Prof. Ir. Dr. Khairul Salleh Mohamed Sahari, Timbalan Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif (Jaminan Kualiti) di Agensi Kelayakan Malaysia (MQA) yang menerangkan kepentingan kelayakan mikro dalam membentuk masa depan pendidikan negara. Program ini merangkumi beberapa sesi panel yang menampilkan pakar-pakar terhormat yang membincangkan topik-topik seperti peranan mikro-kelayakan dalam pendidikan negara dan pembangunan kerjaya. Panel-panel terdiri daripada profesional industri, termasuk Benjamin Yeoh dari Acestar, dan termasuk ahli panel seperti Ts. Nik Naharuddin Mohd Nasir, Pengarah Bakat Digital & Keupayaan di MDEC, dan Prof. Madya Dr. Boontida Meg Uapipatanakul, Timbalan Pengarah Sumber Akademik & Teknologi Maklumat di RMUTT Thailand. Majlis diserikan dengan kehadiran Dato’ Prof. Dr. Mohammad Shatar Sabran, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif MQA, yang merupakan Tetamu Kehormat mewakili Menteri Pengajian Tinggi. Sidang kemuncak itu turut menampilkan ucaptama oleh Natalie Sit, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Kumpulan Acestar dan Pengasas Komuniti Awan Kreatif, dan Puan Jullada Meejul, Timbalan Ketua Pengarah Hal Ehwal Akademik dan Pendidikan di Institut Kelayakan Profesional Thailand (TPQI). Agenda itu seterusnya merangkumi sesi panel mengenai usaha kolaboratif antara universiti dalam mewujudkan pusat ujian peringkat tinggi, majlis pelancaran Sidang Kemuncak Pendidikan Micro-Credentials 2023, gimik dan majlis anugerah, dan siri ceramah teknologi yang memberi tumpuan kepada kerangkuman pendidikan, kreativiti, dan teknologi. Sidang kemuncak itu turut menyaksikan pemeteraian Memorandum Persefahaman (MoU) antara Techcare dan Acestar, yang mempamerkan bilik darjah masa depan oleh Techcare: Acestar X Alliance Bank. Perkongsian ini bertujuan untuk merevolusikan pengalaman pendidikan melalui teknologi dan inovasi. Selain itu, terdapat sesi panel yang mengetengahkan pandangan dan pencapaian juara daripada Kejohanan Kebangsaan Adobe Certified Professional Malaysia. Acara diakhiri dengan majlis anugerah, menghargai juri dan rakan penempatan untuk Kejohanan Kebangsaan Malaysia 2023, dan mengumumkan pemenang pertandingan. Penyertaan UiTM dalam Sidang Kemuncak Pendidikan Micro-Credentials 2023 dan pengiktirafannya sebagai Pusat Ujian Sah Certiport Malaysia (CATC) untuk Microsoft menekankan komitmen universiti untuk menyediakan pelajar dengan peluang pendidikan canggih dan menggalakkan integrasi teknologi dalam proses pembelajaran. Dengan merangkul kelayakan mikro dan memupuk kerjasama, UiTM terus mengukuhkan kedudukannya sebagai institusi terkemuka dalam landskap pendidikan Malaysia.

items.title: TechCare Vulcan Post
items.excerpt: By now, most would have seen the impact that the pandemic has had on businesses nationwide. For starters, around 70% of small medium enterprises (SMEs) experienced a 50% drop in business during the first lockdown. Natalie Sit, the CEO of Acestar and an entrepreneur with 22 years of experience in the IT industry saw that businesses are struggling financially. One area she thought to target to help reduce upfront costs? IT procurement. With irregular and unpredictable lockdowns leading to an uncertain cash flow, companies still had to invest in pricey IT equipment such as laptops and software for their staff, especially with remote working on the rise. The costs of equipping an employee with a capable laptop and software could reach up to RM5,000 per unit. If they were hiring multiple staff at a time, or if there was a need to refresh all the company laptops for an entire team or division, the company would be looking at five-figure payments or more. Thus, the Acestar team came up with TechCare to provide companies with a more flexible package by turning their capital expenditure (CapEx) into operational expenditure (OpEx).

items.title: EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2020 Malaysia
items.excerpt: ENTREPRENEURS are a special breed — they are willing to take risks, have absolute faith in what they believe in and exemplify the strength of the human spirit. items.title: EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2020 Top Nominee
items.excerpt: As the Group CEO of Acestar Sdn Bhd and Founder of the Creative Cloud Community (CCC), Natalie Sit drives innovation and empowers youths to find meaning and purpose in their lives. Today, Acestar is the only Platinum Partner of Adobe Inc in Malaysia, with more than 70% of the education market share. It has also paved the way for the country’s creative multimedia industry, having pioneered the Creative Cloud Community and annually organizing one of the largest creative conferences – SEA Connect. Founded in 2008, Acestar has since propelled itself to becoming one of the leading ICT companies specializing in Cloud licenses and services and helping businesses establish digital workflow. Natalie’s vision is to lead the IT industry into an audacious transformation from the traditional business model to a brand-new IT-as-a-Service (ITaaS) model, with the mission of helping businesses maximize their resources by taking care of all their IT needs.

items.title: An Ace Up Her Sleeve – Natalie Sit Of Acestar Shares Her Vision Of Shaking Up Malaysia’s It Services Industry

items.title: Malaysia’s Pioneer Contestants For Adobe’s Gruelling ACA World Championships Are Ready To Rock And Roll

Held in Florida every year, the event is a gruelling, strenuous, almost Herculean series of design tasks that are made to recognise the finest in the field using Adobe Photoshop, InDesign and Illustrator, the veritable holy trinity of design apps that let you fix everything from a model’s waistline from zero to hero all the way to making sure every single letter on a page is perfectly aligned and ready for print.

items.title: IT Takes Tenacity
items.excerpt: Natalie Sit was an administrative clerk in a small company in a small town who rose to become the CEO of her own IT company, Acestar. MEK ZHIN has the story. IF THERE is a takeaway from the story of Natalie Sit’s rise from administration clerk to CEO of her own company, it is that the way forward in life is to keep learning and improving, and to make the most of the opportunities you’re given.

items.title: Design Your Way To The USA
items.excerpt: IF you have mad designing skills, you stand to win an all expenses-paid trip worth RM18,000 to Orlando, Florida, and a chance to do your country proud. All you have to do is showcase your creative 2D design talent using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign at the Adobe Certified Associate (ACA) Championship Malaysia to design a poster. The winner of the Malaysian championship, organised by local Adobe atinum partner Acestar, will go on to compete at the ACA World Championship, going up against international-level competition.
